name: S DEEP automation
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 20 * * *"
    - cron: "30 4 * * 6"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: "dryrun = test 1080p Short | daily | weekly"
        default: "dryrun"
        type: choice
        options: [dryrun, daily, weekly]
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: sdeep
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      MODE: ${{ github.event.inputs.mode || (github.event.schedule == '30 4 * * 6' && 'weekly' || 'daily') }}
      ENGINE: piper
      GEMINI_MODEL: gemini-3.6-flash
      DRYRUN_ENGINE: piper
      HEYGEN_CONFIRM_BILLING: "false"
      MAX_UPLOADS_PER_RUN: "5"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: Install system dependencies (1080p FFmpeg + Fonts)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -y
          sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-noto-core fonts-dejavu-core
      - name: Install Python dependencies + Commercial-Safe Piper TTS
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install piper-tts
          python3 -m piper.download_voices hi_IN-pratham-medium
      - name: Run Automated Free Pipeline
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          AGNES_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGNES_API_KEY }}
          YT_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.YT_CLIENT_ID }}
          YT_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.YT_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          YT_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.YT_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
        run: python run.py "$MODE"
      - name: Test video (dryrun)
        if: always() && env.MODE == 'dryrun'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dryrun-1080p-video
          path: |
            work/out/*.mp4
            work/out/*.jpg
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: ignore
      - name: Save dryrun preview
        if: always() && env.MODE == 'dryrun'
        run: |
          mkdir -p data
          MP4=$(ls -t work/out/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
          [ -n "$MP4" ] && cp "$MP4" data/dryrun_preview.mp4 || true
          JPG=$(ls -t work/out/*.jpg 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
          [ -n "$JPG" ] && cp "$JPG" data/dryrun_preview.jpg || true
          JSN=$(ls -t work/dryrun_scripts/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
          [ -n "$JSN" ] && cp "$JSN" data/dryrun_preview.json || true
      - name: Save data to GitHub
        if: always()
        run: |
          git config user.name "sdeep-bot"
          git config user.email "bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A data
          git add REPORT.md 2>/dev/null || true
          git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m "auto: $MODE" && git pull --rebase && git push)
